name: file-kind
title: File Kind
description: The one answer to "what is this file and how big is it" — formatBytes (1024 base, one decimal under 10), fileKindOf (MIME first, extension fallback, 25 kinds from images and PDFs to CAD, photometric and design files) and FileTypeIcon/FileKindTile (the lucide icon, tint and label per kind) — shared by Attachment rows, FileViewer, UploadPanel, UploadDialog, AvatarPicker and FolderTree.

meta.whenToUse: Any file surface that shows a size, picks an icon for a file, or branches on what kind of file it holds.
meta.whenNotToUse: Previewing a file (FileViewer) or acquiring one (use-file-drop).
